data.narrative:
Sicona Battery Technologies is a Series A-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector that has raised $22M+ to date. The comparable universe includes one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers spanning battery technology, materials recycling, and adjacent energy infrastructure, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised of $22M as a baseline proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage step-ups yields an implied valuation of $44M. A peer-median approach was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrowly-filtered Climate & Energy cohort; while nine same-sector peers exist, none met the screening criteria of three or more datapoints at equivalent stage or valuation tier.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $37M to $51M, with a median of $44M, derived from a single methodology. Key uncertainties include (1) the absence of tight-stage peer anchoring, which limits precision around the step-up multiplier; (2) the heterogeneity of capital deployment timelines across battery-tech peers; and (3) Sicona's specific technology differentiation relative to the broader cohort. The range reflects methodological constraints rather than fundamental company-level risk assessment.
